title: 经济系统失衡与资源获取困难
description: 经济系统失衡，前期赚钱困难，后期金钱失去意义，任务奖励与投入不成比例，影响游戏进程。
evidence: A licence is $5000, the fine is $15,000. New characters will have ~$100, maybe $600 if you spend a year saving
The economy is poorly balanced: after just a few hours and two or three scrapyard trips, money stops being an issue entirely.
so the save is basically bricked. i can't leave the station until i earn over 7 times what i earned in my entire time in the game over 3 hours

evidence_items.quote: Get a few pennies collecting scrap. Owe more in docking fees. Run out of fuel, not to be able to afford to leave the station to fly to an unknown location to investigate a dead body. Get debt-locked.
evidence_items.description: 捡垃圾收入微薄，停靠费高昂，燃料耗尽后无法离开空间站，陷入债务锁死
evidence_items.quote_zh:
捡废品赚几个子儿。欠的停靠费更多。燃料耗尽，没钱离开空间站飞去未知地点调查一具尸体。陷入债务锁定。卸载。

有些游戏很硬核。但这个简直登峰造极。

另外——地板上像素化的2D杂物毫无意义，你根本不知道什么该捡什么该忽略。而且，没有真正的飞行，只是一个老式雷达风格的屏幕加上更多的2D地图导航。

避开。

evidence_items.quote: The economy is busted and imbalanced, money is completely trivial
evidence_items.description: 经济系统失衡，金钱无意义
evidence_items.quote_zh: 经济系统崩坏且不平衡，金钱完全微不足道

evidence_items.quote: The economy is poorly balanced: after just a few hours and two or three scrapyard trips, money stops being an issue entirely.
evidence_items.description: 经济平衡差，几小时后钱不再是问题
evidence_items.quote_zh: 经济平衡很差：仅仅几个小时后，跑两三趟废料场，钱就完全不再是问题了。

evidence_items.quote: Need at least 5k cash minimum to progress anywhere in the game but game gives you about 100 and a poor tutorial for you to figure out how to scrap for money
evidence_items.description: 游戏只给约100元，但至少需要5000元才能推进，且教程差导致玩家难以赚钱
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在游戏里想在任何地方取得进展，至少需要最低5000现金，但游戏只给你大约100，而且教程很糟糕，让你自己去摸索如何拆解来赚钱

evidence_items.quote: you have to pay off an expensive mortgage that ranges anywhere from $300,000 to over $2M
evidence_items.description: 起始船只需要偿还高额抵押贷款，导致玩家长期负债
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你必须偿还一笔昂贵的抵押贷款，金额从30万美元到超过200万美元不等

evidence_items.quote: can often take you anywhere from 45 minutes to over an hour of IRL time, all for what amounts to only $80,000 - $120,000 of in-game currency
evidence_items.description: 整个打捞-修复-出售循环耗时45分钟到1小时以上，收益仅8-12万
evidence_items.quote_zh: 往往要花掉你 45 分钟到超过一个小时的现实时间，而换来的却只有 80,000 到 120,000 的游戏内货币

evidence_items.quote: A licence is $5000, the fine is $15,000. New characters will have ~$100, maybe $600 if you spend a year saving
evidence_items.description: 打捞许可证5000美元，罚款15000美元，新角色仅约100美元
evidence_items.quote_zh: 执照要5000美元，罚款是15000美元。新角色大约会有100美元，如果你攒一年的话也许能有600美元

evidence_items.quote: it takes hours to break down any ship part into scrap worth more than a few dollars
evidence_items.description: 拆解船只部件耗时数小时，收益仅几美元
evidence_items.quote_zh: 把任何飞船部件拆解成价值超过几美元的废料都要花上好几个小时

evidence_items.quote: Also, you can spend an entire year of your life in character customization to maybe raise a few hundred dollars, but you can spend 2 irl minutes the second you get into the game to do a delivery gig that takes like 20 seconds and awards thousands if you do it fast?
evidence_items.description: 经济系统不平衡，任务奖励与角色创建投入不成比例
evidence_items.quote_zh: 另外，你可以在角色自定义上花掉一整年的生命，也许只能多赚几百美元，但你可以在进入游戏的那一刻花2分钟现实时间去做一个送货任务，这个任务只需大约20秒，如果做得快就能奖励数千美元？

evidence_items.quote: 前期的拆船和捡废品的所能赚的钱十分有限
evidence_items.description: 前期拆船和捡废品赚钱十分有限
evidence_items.quote_zh: 前期的拆船和捡废品的所能赚的钱十分有限

evidence_items.quote: so the save is basically bricked. i can't leave the station until i earn over 7 times what i earned in my entire time in the game over 3 hours
evidence_items.description: 存档因罚款无法离开空间站而彻底卡死，无法继续游戏
evidence_items.quote_zh: 所以这个存档基本上算是废了。我无法离开空间站，除非我赚到超过我在游戏里3个多小时全部收入7倍以上的钱

evidence_items.quote: The money curve is all off, for a game that tries to be about scavenging ships its more $/hr couriering bottles of vodka and patches between train stations.
evidence_items.description: 赚钱曲线失衡，跑腿送快递比打捞飞船更赚钱
evidence_items.quote_zh: 金钱曲线完全不对，对于一个试图以打捞船只为主题的游戏来说，它更像是按小时计费在火车站之间运送伏特加酒瓶和补丁。

evidence_items.quote: And then you come across a ship with a fusion reactor just sitting there and its worth $100k-200k and poof there goes your money troubles, and the whole point of playing.
evidence_items.description: 遇到带聚变反应堆的船可卖10-20万，直接解决金钱问题，使游戏失去意义
evidence_items.quote_zh: 然后你遇到一艘就停在那里的带有聚变反应堆的船，它价值10万到20万，噗，你的金钱烦恼就没了，玩这游戏的全部意义也没了。

evidence_items.quote: you can get a lot of stuff, but cannot sell it all
evidence_items.description: 可以获取大量物品但无法全部出售
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你能弄到很多东西，但没法把它们全卖掉
